content:
# Disagreement Log — 1QS Column 4

| # | Line | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Category | Resolution |
|---|------|------|-------|--------|----------|------------|
| 1 | 4:1 | patience-of temper | patience | long-suffering | word choice | SOPHIA: "patience" -- LOGOS balances readability and fidelity |
| 2 | 4:3 | covenant-faithfulness | lovingkindness | faithful love | word choice | SOPHIA: "lovingkindness" -- established DSS convention from LOGOS |
| 3 | 4:4 | holy intent | holy purpose | sacred resolve | word choice | SOPHIA: "holy purpose" -- follows LOGOS |
| 4 | 4:5 | glorious purity | glorious purity | radiant purity | word choice | SOPHIA: "radiant purity" -- PNEUMA conveys tahor with stronger force |
| 5 | 4:6 | concealing the-truth-of | concealing the truth of | guarding the truth of | interpretive | SOPHIA: "guarding" -- PNEUMA's verb conveys protective sense |
| 6 | 4:6 | sons-of truth | Sons of Truth | who belong to the truth | structural | SOPHIA: "Sons of Truth" -- LOGOS capitalization as sectarian title |
| 7 | 4:6 | the-visitation-of all | the visitation of all | what awaits all | word choice | SOPHIA: "the reward of all" -- compromise rendering |
| 8 | 4:7 | abundance-of peace | great peace | deep peace | word choice | SOPHIA: "great peace" -- follows LOGOS |
| 9 | 4:8 | light-of perpetuity | eternal light | never-fading light | word choice | SOPHIA: "unending light" -- compromise |
| 10 | 4:9 | slackness-of hands | slackness of hands | neglect of what is right | interpretive | SOPHIA: "neglect of righteous service" -- midpoint rendering |
| 11 | 4:11 | ways-of defilement | ways of defilement | corrupt behavior | word choice | SOPHIA: "corrupt ways" -- partial dynamic adaptation |
| 12 | 4:14 | eternal perdition | eternal perdition | everlasting ruin | word choice | SOPHIA: "eternal ruin" -- combines EMET "eternal" with PNEUMA "ruin" |
| 13 | 4:15 | the-shame-of extinction | the shame of extinction | the disgrace of annihilation | word choice | SOPHIA: "the shame of annihilation" -- hybrid |
| 14 | 4:17 | sons-of man | sons of humanity | human being | word choice | SOPHIA: "humanity" -- accessible without losing collective sense |
| 15 | 4:18 | each-man's inheritance | the division to which they belong | how much of each spirit they possess | interpretive | SOPHIA: follows LOGOS formulation |
| 16 | 4:21 | do-not walk together | do not walk together | can never coexist | structural | SOPHIA: "cannot walk together" -- slightly stronger than LOGOS |
| 17 | 4:22 | come-forth perpetually | arise in the world forever | emerge into the world permanently | word choice | SOPHIA: "arise in the world forever" -- follows LOGOS |
| 18 | 4:23 | the-dominion-of injustice | the dominion of injustice | wrongdoing's oppressive rule | structural | SOPHIA: "the dominion of injustice" -- EMET/LOGOS |
| 19 | 4:24 | the-frame-of man | the body of man | human nature itself | interpretive | SOPHIA: "the frame of humanity" -- EMET's yetser with inclusive noun |
| 20 | 4:25 | waters-of-purification | purifying waters | cleansing water | word choice | SOPHIA: "purifying waters" -- follows LOGOS |
| 21 | 4:26 | to make-wise the-perfect-of way | to give wisdom to the blameless | giving insight to the blameless | structural | SOPHIA: "giving wisdom to the blameless of way" -- hybrid |
| 22 | 4:26 | the-glory-of Adam | the glory of Adam | Adam's glory | structural | SOPHIA: "the glory of Adam" -- preserves construct order |
